newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS share index sets record 436.02-brokers.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS share index sets record 436.02-brokers.

text.p: The Russian Trading System index of 22 leading shares rose to a record 436.02 on strong volumes at 1000 GMT on Wednesday after closing on Tuesday at 423.87, the NAUFOR brokers association said.

The previous record was set on July 25, when the index hit 433.12 on record $96.3 million share turnover. Traders said foreign investors are pouring funds into Russia at the beginning of the third quarter.
